avis.titre: Reliable Lotion for Acne Prone Skin
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Absolutely love the effortless mess free packaging. The bottle is easy to close and helps with keeping things hygienic. This lotion isn't for the dry skin girlies. I have combination skin but sometimes lean towards the dry skin area. I suffer with acne and using this lotion has been really helpful in keeping my skin smoother and overall less pigmented from post acne marks and it never irritated my skin. However, if you are someone who needs more moisture in your routine you may need to use a hydrating serum before this lotion since it's thin in consistency and not heavy. I'm not sure if it's user error but since finishing this lotion in winter I'm peeling in some areas of my skin and this may or may not be the lotion but it was something I noticed. My one complaint of this lotion is that it contains titanium dioxide and it's something that I don't really mind, it may be something to consider.

avis.texte: I've been using the First Aid Beauty Daily Resurfacing Lotion with 2% Niacinamide and I honestly really like it.
